searchText: Can we get a recording on YouTube please? <timbeiko> Will upload 🔜 There you gol, <@365300888354422794> 🙂 https://youtu.be/SRW-NdnzcSc Hi, is there somewhere I can see the research output/outcome from the recipients of academic grants of 2023? It seems most client teams already have a release out that's dencun ready, and a few have had >1 release since setting the mainnet fork times. To make sure we put the right ones in the announcement, could teams please confirm the actual release to use in a thread here 😄 ? TY! Yes, https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/releases/tag/v24.2.1 is the Nimbus mainnet Dencun release (edit: not in thread; thread didn't exist when response created)
